headline: This law directs the federal government to offer to transfer certain federal land in Albuquerque, New Mexico, to the Amy Biehl High School Foundation.
what_it_does: The General Services Administration must offer to convey specified federal lands in Albuquerque to the Amy Biehl High School Foundation. The transfer must follow a fair market value appraisal that the Administrator finds acceptable. The Foundation pays the costs of the transfer, and the conveyance must happen within three years of enactment.

who_it_affects.how: The Foundation would receive an offer of federal land in Albuquerque and must pay the costs related to the transfer.
The agency must make the offer, work from a fair market value appraisal, and complete the conveyance within three years.

when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect on November 26, 2014, and the conveyance must occur within three years of that date, by about November 26, 2017.
